info.title: SEO OS
info.description: An autonomous search growth platform. The client connects their accounts, approves content, and the rest runs itself.

schema.title: Response Me Api V1 Auth Me Get
Response List Sites Api V1 Sites Get

post.description:
Skip onboarding and start the recurring programme immediately.

Onboarding normally flips this, but a client who already knows their
setup should not have to wait for a mission to finish before the weekly
cycle can be scheduled.

get.description: Everything the main screen needs, in one round trip.

schema.title: Response List Findings Api V1 Sites  Site Id  Findings Get
Response List Pages Api V1 Sites  Site Id  Pages Get
Response List Approvals Api V1 Approvals Get

get.description:
Pending approvals batched the way the client should act on them.

Forty alt-text fixes are one decision, not forty. Presenting them
individually is what trains people to click approve without reading.

schema.title: Response Grouped Api V1 Approvals Grouped Get

post.description:
Decide a batch at once.

High and critical risk items are excluded even when they appear in the
list: those must be looked at individually, and a bulk endpoint that
lets one click ship a critical change is a design failure.

schema.title: Response Bulk Decide Api V1 Approvals Bulk Post
Response List Content Api V1 Content Get

get.description:
What the client actually has to look at.

Each item carries its gate results, so a reviewer can see that the
automated checks already passed and their job is judging substance.

schema.title: Response Review Queue Api V1 Content Review Queue Get

patch.description:
Let a client edit a draft directly rather than only accept or reject.

Most review friction is a sentence somebody wants changed. Forcing a full
rejection cycle for that is why review queues stall.

get.description: Every version, so the client can see exactly what they approved.

schema.title: Response Versions Api V1 Content  Content Id  Versions Get

post.description: The client's decision. This is the whole job the product asks of them.

get.description:
What can be connected, what each unlocks, and what it needs.

The onboarding UI is generated from this, so a new connector appears in
the product without a front-end change.

schema.title: Response Get Catalogue Api V1 Integrations Catalogue Get
Response List Integrations Api V1 Integrations Get

post.description:
Store a credential and prove it works with a real call.

Verifying immediately matters: a stored key that does not work produces
silently empty reports for weeks, and the client blames the platform.

schema.title: Response Connect Api V1 Integrations Connect Post
Response Verify Api V1 Integrations  Integration Id  Verify Post
Response List Missions Api V1 Missions Get

post.description:
Queue a mission and return immediately.

Missions take minutes. Holding an HTTP request open for that is how a
proxy timeout turns into a half-finished run with no record.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api V1 Sites  Site Id  Runs Get

get.description: A full trace: steps, agents, and every tool call they made.

schema.title: Response Get Run Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Get
Response List Schedules Api V1 Sites  Site Id  Schedules Get

get.description: The roster, so a client can see who is working on their account.

schema.title: Response List Agents Api V1 Agents Get
Response Get Profile Api V1 Sites  Site Id  Brand Profile Get

patch.description:
Let the client correct the voice profile.

The platform derives a first pass from their own writing, but they know
their brand better than any inference does, and an uncorrectable profile
is one they stop trusting.

schema.title: Response List Assets Api V1 Sites  Site Id  Brand Assets Get

post.description:
Upload brand material: style guides, case studies, price lists, decks.

Text is extracted and indexed immediately so writers can use it in the
next run rather than after a batch job nobody watches.
